prerequisite: The N128x2 small-M integrated run has an authenticated successful execution and measured 75.5962 C1 tokens/s; active runtime files equal the measured commit.
question: What now dominates integrated small-M P8 decode time?
rivals: FC1 compressed weight decoding or work scheduling
dense native MMA and GEMV outside routed experts
workload: One fresh server; one warm and one recorded synthetic 32768-token request; 34 completion tokens each; exactly 16 recorded decode steps per rank.
analysis_before_result: Group graph kernels by per-worker cudaGraphLaunch correlationId. Verify 16 launches/ranges per rank and repeated node inventories. Require 42 dynamic FC1, 42 small-M FC2, and 42 top-k reductions per replay. Report per-rank category sums and interval unions, FC1/FC2, dense MMA/GEMV, attention, fills, communication and top kernel names. Use latest finish minus earliest start for distributed span; never sum ranks.
decision: Choose the largest measured actionable category on the critical ranks. If MoE ceases to dominate, investigate the measured external cost. A small change that cannot plausibly recover the approximately 2.27 ms unprofiled token-time deficit will not justify another product benchmark.
stopping: One trace attempt; no kernel edits during collection. Any failed attempt is preserved and needs a new destination before retry.
experimental_unit: One freshly started server; 16 sequential graph replays are correlated subsamples. No confidence interval or independent replication claim.
operations: Acquire model-stack lock, verify no active GPU compute processes, record and restore backend/timer state, preserve owned container logs and traces, keep environment dumps private.
claim_boundary: Diagnostic kernel attribution on TP4/noEP/DCP1. Nsight adds overhead; this is not a product throughput or KLD result. P8 E4M3 mxf8f6f4 requires twice NVFP4 MMA issue count for equal K.
